/playbook/execution.title: Execution

/non-coders/proof.title: The Proof
/non-coders/proof.description: Real professionals who beat thousands of developers at major hackathons.

/non-coders/setup.title: Getting Started
/non-coders/setup.description: The 3 files, 4 shortcuts, and daily workflow you need to start building.

/non-coders/concepts.title: Concepts Explained
/non-coders/concepts.description: GitHub, APIs, deploying, and other jargon explained in plain English.

/non-coders/apis.title: Using APIs
/non-coders/apis.description: How to add any service to your app with just a key and a docs link.

/non-coders/system-prompt.title: The System Prompt
/non-coders/system-prompt.description: The CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md files that set the rules your AI follows every session. One command sets up both.

/non-coders/skills.title: Skills & Commands
/non-coders/skills.description: Installable AI skills and slash commands that teach your AI to work with non-coders.

/non-coders/skills/non-coder-mode.title: Non-Coder Mode
/non-coders/skills/non-coder-mode.description: Core guardrails for non-coders. Tells the AI to explain everything in plain English, break tasks into small steps, and never assume coding knowledge.

/non-coders/skills/domain-to-spec.title: Domain to Spec
/non-coders/skills/domain-to-spec.description: Run this FIRST. Captures your domain expertise and writes AGENTS.md and PRD.md to the repo root. Every other scaffold skill reads these files.

/non-coders/skills/quickstart.title: Quickstart
/non-coders/skills/quickstart.description: One-shot project bootstrapper. Chains domain-to-spec, scaffold-frontend, and scaffold-backend (if needed) with user confirmation between steps.

/non-coders/skills/scaffold-frontend.title: Scaffold Frontend
/non-coders/skills/scaffold-frontend.description: PRD-driven Next.js scaffold into clients/. Reads AGENTS.md and PRD.md, generates pages, layout, types, and an API client. Refuses to run without both files.

/non-coders/skills/scaffold-backend.title: Scaffold Backend
/non-coders/skills/scaffold-backend.description: PRD-driven FastAPI scaffold into server/ with optional Supabase. One stub route per entry in PRD.md > Backend Routes. Skips automatically if Backend Needed? = No.

/non-coders/skills/v0-prompt-crafter.title: v0 Prompt Crafter
/non-coders/skills/v0-prompt-crafter.description: Turn a PRD or product description into a production-grade Vercel v0 prompt. Researches the industry, commits to a bold aesthetic, picks fancy UI libraries (shadcn, Aceternity, Magic UI, Motion), and assembles a copy-paste prompt.

/non-coders/skills/feature-builder.title: Feature Builder
/non-coders/skills/feature-builder.description: Structured workflow for implementing a new feature. Returns a plan, files list, commands, test steps, and rollback plan.

/non-coders/skills/bugfix-doctor.title: Bugfix Doctor
/non-coders/skills/bugfix-doctor.description: Systematic bug-fixing workflow. Walks through reproduce, isolate, fix, test, and verify. Explains all errors in plain English.

/non-coders/skills/demo-prep.title: Demo Prep
/non-coders/skills/demo-prep.description: Produces a step-by-step live demo script for hackathon presentations. Covers the problem, walkthrough, and outcome with a backup plan.

/non-coders/skills/readme-writer.title: GitHub Writer
/non-coders/skills/readme-writer.description: Turns your finished project into a winner-grade GitHub README: a centered hero, badges, a clickable demo video, an architecture diagram, and team cards, then sets the repo's About description, website, and topics so recruiters and judges can find it.
